{{- /* The page's trail, from the site root down. params.breadcrumbs.root ({name, url} list) goes in front, for crumbs above this site (the live docs start with "All Products"); params.productName names the site root crumb, which is otherwise the site title. */ -}} {{- if (default true site.Params.features.breadcrumbs) -}} {{- $ancestors := .Ancestors.Reverse -}} {{- if $ancestors -}} {{- $cfg := site.Params.breadcrumbs | default dict -}} {{- /* A version's own home ("Home" under the site root) is what the site crumb already names, so on that page the trail ends at the site crumb instead of adding "Home" after it. */ -}} {{- $onContentHome := and .Parent .Parent.IsHome (eq .LinkTitle "Home") -}} {{- $siteName := site.Params.productName -}}
{{- range $cfg.root -}} {{ .name }} / {{- end -}} {{- range $i, $a := $ancestors -}} {{- $isContentHome := and $a.Parent $a.Parent.IsHome (eq $a.LinkTitle "Home") -}} {{- if not $isContentHome -}} {{- if $i }}/{{ end -}} {{- $name := cond $a.IsHome ($siteName | default $a.LinkTitle) $a.LinkTitle -}} {{- if and $onContentHome $a.IsHome -}} {{ $name }} {{- else -}} {{ $name }} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- if not $onContentHome -}} / {{ .LinkTitle }} {{- end -}}
{{- end -}} {{- end -}}
